content.summary: Research findings for: OpenCode native Claude Agent SDK tool call lifecycle and subagent sessions

data.original_input: Explore OpenCode to understand how the native agents SDK handles tool calls: integration, tool call lifecycle, and session/subagent architecture.

codebase_findings.notes: Routes providerID=claude-agent-sdk through streamClaudeNative, manages SDK session resume via ClaudeAgentSDKSessionStore, adds _providerExecuted tool stub, and merges tool validation/repair for provider-executed calls.

Implements streamClaudeNative using Claude Agent SDK query(); converts SDK messages to ClaudeNativeStreamEvent (text, reasoning, tool-call/result/error); normalizes tool names/params; handles tool_use, tool_result, tool_progress/tool_use_summary; uses includePartialMessages for streaming.

Creates MCP server for OpenCode tools, pre-creates ToolPart before execution, buffers metadata updates, applies Plugin hooks tool.execute.before/after, and uses PermissionNext in tool context; maps MCP and registry tools to SDK handlers.

Consumes LLM stream events; creates ToolPart on tool-input-start, transitions to running on tool-call, completes on tool-result, errors on tool-error; merges metadata; updates step start/finish and session usage.
Defines ToolPart state machine (pending/running/completed/error) and Bus events (message.part.updated) used for tool progress signaling; converts tool parts to model messages.
Builds AI SDK ToolSet for non-native providers; wraps tool execution with Plugin hooks; constructs Tool.Context with ctx.metadata() updates; processes subtask parts by calling TaskTool.

Creates child sessions for subagents (parentID set to current session), streams subagent tool updates back to parent via Bus subscription + ctx.metadata, enforces max_delegation_depth, and returns task metadata in output.
Session Info includes parentID and depth; createNext computes depth for subagent sessions and persists session metadata.
Persists SDK session IDs per OpenCode session to resume Claude Agent SDK conversations across requests.

patterns: Provider-executed tool calls (Claude Agent SDK) are surfaced as stream events and mapped into MessageV2.ToolPart state transitions.
Tool progress and metadata updates flow through Session.updatePart + Bus (message.part.updated) events.
Tool-bridge pre-creates ToolParts to enable ctx.metadata() during provider-side tool execution, with buffering for out-of-order metadata updates.
Subagent sessions are modeled as child sessions (parentID, depth) and reported back to the parent via Task tool metadata updates.
raw_options: Trace tool call progress by subscribing to MessageV2.Event.PartUpdated during a live Claude SDK session to validate events emitted for tool lifecycle states.
Map Claude SDK stream event variants (tool_use/tool_result/tool_use_summary/tool_progress) to internal ToolPart updates and document where metadata is dropped.
Verify subagent parent-child propagation by following TaskTool -> SessionPrompt.prompt -> Bus subscriptions to see how child tool calls surface in the parent session.
Compare AI SDK tool execution path vs Claude SDK path to identify divergences in state updates and metadata handling.
Check ToolMetadataRegistry usage (currently store-only) and identify where metadata retrieval should be wired for tool_use_summary enrichment.
Review toModelMessages tool serialization to understand what the client can see for pending/running tool calls.
